feeds.title: Big Sky Political Analysis
feeds.description: Created and maintained by professors of political science at Montana State University, this website seeks to bring political science analysis to current political events in Montana, the United States, and across the globe. The main aim is to provide nonpartisan analysis and commentary in a political world replete with punditry and partisanship.
